description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLogDecorator class, which provides a decorator pattern for the TimesheetActionLog entity. It includes methods for formatting the date, getting a label for the action, and setting the user ID associated with a timesheet action log entry.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the TimesheetActionLog entity, providing additional methods for formatted date, action label, and setting associated user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a TimesheetActionLog entity.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the timesheet action log formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getActionLabel
methods.description: Returns the action as a properly formatted label (e.g., 'Submitted', 'Approved').

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the action, based on a user ID.
